title: Colours and How to Mix Them
summary: Primary colours, mixing, and warm and cool colours.

steps.title: Three primary colours
sentences: In painting, the three primary colours are red, yellow and blue.
You cannot make them by mixing other colours.
All other paint colours can be made from them.

steps.title: Mixing
sentences: Blue and red make purple, and these are called secondary colours.

steps.title: Light and dark
sentences: Add white to a colour to make it lighter, and add a tiny bit of black or a darker colour to make it darker.
A colour with white added is called a tint.
Try making five shades of blue.

steps.title: Warm and cool
sentences: Red, orange and yellow are warm colours that remind us of fire and sun.
Blue, green and purple are cool colours that remind us of water and grass.
Artists use them to show mood.

facts: Light mixes differently to paint: the primary colours of light are red, green and blue.
The kolam designs outside Tamil homes often use rice flour in white and sometimes bright colours.
Rangoli designs use coloured powders and petals.
